en: Dina has a striped sunflower seed. She pushes it into a pot of soil, just a finger deep.
Every morning, Dina gives the pot a little drink of water. Not too much, not too little.
One day a tiny green shoot pokes up. 'It's awake!' Dina whispers.
Dina puts the pot by the sunny window. The shoot grows taller and gets more leaves.
Weeks later, the stem is taller than Dina. At the top, a big yellow flower opens and turns its face to the light.
When the flower dries, Dina finds lots of new striped seeds in the middle. 'Now I can plant more!'
id: Dina punya sebutir biji bunga matahari yang bergaris. Ia menekannya ke dalam pot berisi tanah, sedalam satu ruas jari.
Setiap pagi, Dina memberi pot itu sedikit air. Tidak terlalu banyak, tidak terlalu sedikit.
Suatu hari, tunas hijau kecil muncul. 'Dia bangun!' bisik Dina.
Dina menaruh pot di dekat jendela yang cerah. Tunasnya tumbuh makin tinggi dan daunnya bertambah.
Beberapa minggu kemudian, batangnya lebih tinggi dari Dina. Di puncaknya, bunga kuning besar mekar dan menghadap ke arah cahaya.
Saat bunganya kering, Dina menemukan banyak biji bergaris baru di tengahnya. 'Sekarang aku bisa menanam lagi!'

readAloudNotes.en: Press one finger into your child's palm like planting a seed.
readAloudNotes.id: Tekan satu jari ke telapak tangan anak seperti menanam biji.

readAloudNotes.en: Make a gentle 'pshhh' sound and pretend to pour from a watering can.
readAloudNotes.id: Buat bunyi 'sssh' pelan dan pura-pura menuang dari gembor.

readAloudNotes.en: Curl up small with your child, then poke one finger up slowly.
readAloudNotes.id: Meringkuk kecil bersama anak, lalu munculkan satu jari pelan-pelan.

readAloudNotes.en: Rise slowly from crouching to kneeling, spreading your hands as leaves.
readAloudNotes.id: Bangkit pelan dari jongkok ke berlutut sambil membuka tangan seperti daun.

readAloudNotes.en: Stand tall, stretch up high and open your hands wide like petals.
readAloudNotes.id: Berdiri tegak, regangkan tangan ke atas, dan buka tangan lebar seperti kelopak.

readAloudNotes.en: Pretend to pick seeds from your palm and count a few together.
readAloudNotes.id: Pura-pura mengambil biji dari telapak tangan dan hitung beberapa bersama.

objectives.en: Retells the life of a plant in order: seed, shoot, plant, flower, new seeds.
objectives.id: Menceritakan kembali urutan hidup tanaman: biji, tunas, tanaman, bunga, biji baru.

objectives.en: Names what a plant needs to grow: soil, water and light.
objectives.id: Menyebut kebutuhan tanaman untuk tumbuh: tanah, air, dan cahaya.

meaning.en: the small part a new plant grows from
meaning.id: bagian kecil tempat tanaman baru tumbuh

meaning.en: the first green part of a plant to come up
meaning.id: bagian hijau pertama tanaman yang muncul

meaning.en: the part of a plant that holds it up

prompt.en: What came up first from the soil?
prompt.id: Apa yang pertama muncul dari tanah?

prompt.en: What did Dina give her plant every morning?
prompt.id: Apa yang Dina berikan kepada tanamannya setiap pagi?

prompt.en: Why did Dina move the pot to the window?
prompt.id: Mengapa Dina memindahkan pot ke dekat jendela?

en: so the plant could get light from the sun
so the plant could see outside
to keep it away from water
id: agar tanaman bisa melihat ke luar

prompt.en: What did Dina find in the dried flower?
prompt.id: Apa yang Dina temukan di bunga yang kering?

connection.en: Plants grow from seeds and need soil, water and light; a flower can make new seeds.
connection.id: Tanaman tumbuh dari biji dan butuh tanah, air, dan cahaya; bunga dapat menghasilkan biji baru.

discussionPrompts.en: What would happen if Dina forgot to water her plant?
discussionPrompts.id: Apa yang terjadi jika Dina lupa menyiram tanamannya?

discussionPrompts.en: What would you like to grow?

offlineActivity.en: Plant a large seed (such as a sunflower or bean seed from a garden pack) in a cup of soil with your child. The adult handles the seed packet; water it together each morning and draw how it changes.
offlineActivity.id: Tanam biji yang besar (misalnya biji bunga matahari atau kacang dari paket benih) di gelas berisi tanah bersama anak. Orang dewasa memegang paket benih; siram bersama setiap pagi dan gambar perubahannya.

factChecks.claim: Plants need water and light to grow.
Sunflowers can grow taller than a young child and make many seeds in the flower head.

safetyNotes.en: An adult keeps the seed packet; seeds are planted straight away and never eaten. Wash hands after handling soil.
safetyNotes.id: Orang dewasa menyimpan paket benih; biji langsung ditanam dan tidak dimakan. Cuci tangan setelah memegang tanah.
